title: French Pilaf with Fernbrake and Gosari
description: A hearty and flavorful French-inspired pilaf dish featuring fernbrake and gosari. This recipe is perfect for a satisfying dinner.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of dense in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped irish and sauté for 2 minutes.
Add the sliced fernbrake and gosari and sauté for 3 minutes.
Add the French-style rice blend and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the ucitrusy juice and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
